title: Dramatic Structure — Elements
skills: identify major elements of dramatic structure
analyze how conflict and plot develop across a play
explain how structural choices shape tension and resolution
apply dramatic structure concepts when reading and analyzing plays
alignment_note: Introduces the major elements of dramatic structure and how they organize action, conflict, tension, and resolution in plays. Supports close reading of drama, plot analysis, structural interpretation, and evidence-based discussion of dramatic texts across high school English courses.
